svg.title: Symmetric allocation of a weight tensor
svg.desc: A weight tensor of N rows by K is split into four row ranges of R = ceil(N/4) rows. The host repacks the rows and writes range c into DDR4 channel c, at the same offset W_OFF in every channel, where rows sit back to back: row r of channel c starts at W_OFF + (r - c*R) x ROW_BEATS(fmt, K). Cluster c streams only channel c, so one MVM names the tensor with one offset.
